g.title: VitalWatchArchitecture
g.text: Browser client · IBM LinuxONE application host · optional external Gemini

g.title: api
g.text: Session cookies · CSRF · role / assignment checks
Patients, alerts, review, handovers and family updates

g.title: model
g.text: Research score and supplied feature contributions

g.title: db
g.text: Readings, scores, alerts and care events
Review checkpoints, handovers and family updates
Durable language jobs and generated results

g.title: gemini
g.text: API key stays in the LinuxONE backend

g.title: note
g.text: Direct Python service; one process with background tasks.
SQLite is persistent local storage on the VM.
The browser receives no Gemini key.
Gemini cannot change scores or resolve alerts.
